# Test fixtures

`wil-test-fixture-key` is a freshly generated, disposable RSA private key created solely for this project's `Convert-OpenSshKeyToPpk` tests. It has never been used against any real host and grants access to nothing, so it is safe to have checked into this repository despite looking like a real private key. If a secret scanner (for example GitHub push protection) flags it, this file is the explanation.
